description_en: Calls the UpdateSet operation to update the display name of a media set
description_zh: 调用UpdateSet接口更新媒体集的显示名称
kebab_example: aliyun imm update-set --project immtest --set-id Set-e8dd5e4e-99f7-43d4-80d5-3456a5bd5077 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSet

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en: The display name of the media set
parameters.name: set_name

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the media set

ModifyTime.description_en:
The modification time of the media set.

After the media set is created, if the media set has not been updated, the modification time is the same as the creation time
ModifyTime.description_zh:
媒体集的修改时间。

创建媒体集后，如果未更新过媒体集，则媒体集的修改时间和媒体集的创建时间相同

SetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the media set, which is the same as the value in the request
SetId.description_zh: 媒体集的唯一标识，和请求时一致

SetName.description_en:
The display name of the media set.

If this parameter is not specified when updating the media set, the return value is the current display name of the media set
SetName.description_zh:
媒体集的显示名称。

如果更新媒体集时未设置此参数，则返回值为媒体集当前的显示名称
